description: This file defines a PHP class named AboutOrganization within the OrangeHRM Admin DTO namespace. The class models information about an organization such as company name, version, active employees, and past employees, providing getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: AboutOrganization
classes.description: Data transfer object representing organizational information such as company name, version, active and past employee counts.

methods.name: getNumberOfActiveEmployee
methods.description: Returns the number of active employees.

methods.name: setNumberOfActiveEmployee
methods.description: Sets the number of active employees.

methods.name: getNumberOfPastEmployee
methods.description: Returns the number of past employees.

methods.name: setNumberOfPastEmployee
methods.description: Sets the number of past employees.
